$description: LineChart and AreaChart (platform/charts/LineChart.jsx, AreaChart.jsx, line-chart.css; library wave 9, lane A): the point on a value and the fill of an area. Lines, colors and axes are the chart frame's tokens; the series' colors are the data-viz scales.

line-chart-point-radius.$description: Line chart: the radius of a point on a value (points).

area-chart-fill-opacity.$description: Area chart: the fill of an area that may overlap another (stack none): see-through.

area-chart-stacked-fill-opacity.$description: Area chart: the fill of a stacked or percent area: nearly solid, the line on top keeps the edges apart.
